releaseNotes: Expands the offline passage-commentary library from 163 to 173 contextual studies, adding carefully qualified exposition on Judges, Esther, Ecclesiastes, Daniel, Hosea, Amos, Habakkuk, Galatians, Colossians and 1 Thessalonians. Each entry includes historical or literary context, study observations, interpretive cautions and cross-references checked against the bundled KJV.
